_help: W5 overlay art (breakable block Z, spike trap X, solid decoration Y). mem/ovtile.mem is GENERATED from this file.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_overlay_mem.py
pics 0..2 = Z / X / Y (3 = spare). file = 16x16 picture, scale 2 -> 32x32. cut = exact [r,g,b] colours that become see-through. plate = [r,g,b] rectangle under the picture.
Missing / invalid file -> a procedural placeholder (printed warning), the game still builds. Keys starting with _ are comments.
